note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

policy.title: Policy divergence
policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: Fed chorus split, same shape: Waller leans hold, Williams says one more in 2026 but none needed in 2027, Collins backs another hike this year — FedWatch Oct ~19-22%, Dec ~85%. CPI Wed 7:30am CT is the test; Fed blackout from Sat Oct 17.

growth.title: Growth differentials
growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: US resilient on the day's evidence: home sales +1.5% m/m beat, bank earnings mixed-to-solid, IMF lifted 2026 global growth to 3.1%. NFIB slipped to 97.9 — small business is the soft spot.

inflation.title: Inflation
inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: US CPI Wed 7:30am CT (3.6% y/y, core m/m 0.2%, core y/y 2.5%) — the last big print before FOMC Oct 27-28. NFIB: inflation top problem for 20% of small businesses (+4pts). China CPI tonight 8:30pm CT.

risk.title: Risk sentiment
risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Risk proxies firmed with the dollar's fade (AUD +0.35%, NZD +0.46%, CAD +0.47%) while Asia's chip rout continued (KOSPI -6.2%) — fear is sectoral, not systemic; no safe-haven dash for the dollar.

tot.title: Terms of trade
tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent ~$104.5-105.4, WTI ~$92.2-92.5; spread ~$12.3 still wide — the premium is shipping/geopolitics; the Russian diesel story keeps leaking it.

positioning.title: Positioning
positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: COT w/e Oct 6: EUR/GBP shorts at the ~0th percentile — the squeeze thesis got its first test (EUR +0.39%); AUD shorts at the ~2nd with record gross; yen longs 62,325 at ~86th; USD aggregate longs ~$35.5bn crowded into Wednesday's CPI.

fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk
fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: France's budget plenary debate under way — no verified vote outcome; revenue vote Oct 20, Moody's Oct 23. Dimon warned on large US fiscal deficits.
